name: CaseBlockRootShrinkToFit
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "block-root-shrink-to-fit" (invariant). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a display:block root that filled NOTHING — the flex stage made it a flex item and it shrink-to-fit its content, so its computed width is a harness-text measurement (the astryx.card 114.203px family)
